scientific_limitations: The exact formulas are a short consequence of finite injectivity, quantifier-free type classification, and the finite q-binomial theorem, so folklore risk remains.
The result is only for fixed finite fields and does not apply to the two-sorted varying-field theory.
Ordered tuple orbits are counted; no congruence classification of bilinear forms is asserted.
title: Exact product tuple-orbit profiles for homogeneous finite-field bilinear spaces
